question: What is uncreated, and what is other, in pure-self-freedom I-nature?
premises: therefore indeed from pure-self-freedom-I-nature, this from uncreated
inference: Pure-freedom-I is uncreated; the other is made — 'krti' marks it.
plain_english: Therefore indeed from pure-self-freedom-I-nature, this from uncreated — but the other, so said, from the word krti.
